# Error code reference

All 560 `TQL-*` codes, scanned from the framework sources on every refresh and grouped by domain. The meaning is extracted from the raising site (its message text, with dynamic parts shown as `…`), the raising files are the provenance, and where a cookbook page discusses a code, it is linked. An undocumented code still appears — that is the point of an index.
